name: Reverse Crunch
summary: A floor ab exercise that curls the pelvis toward the ribs to train the lower abs.
setup: Lie on your back with hips and knees bent to 90 degrees.
Place your arms by your sides or hold something behind your head.
execution: Curl your pelvis off the floor by drawing your knees toward your chest.
Lift your hips a few inches using your abs, not momentum.
Lower slowly until your tailbone touches the floor.
mistakes: Using momentum: slow down and pause at the top.
Pulling with arms: keep them relaxed.
Rolling onto the neck: keep the lift small.
Dropping the hips quickly: lower under control.
